newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan brokerages weak on sokaiya concerns.
newsitem.headline: Japan brokerages weak on sokaiya concerns.

text.p: Shares in Japanese brokerages except for Nomura Securities Co Ltd fell in Tokyo morning trade on Friday, depressed by concerns over possible ties with "sokaiya" or corporate racketeers, brokers said.
At midday, Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd was down 14 yen at 385. Daiwa Securities Co Ltd had shed 24 yen to stand at 883. Nikko Securities Co Ltd fell 28 yen to 702.

Japanese media have speculated that the sokaiya-related firm linked to Nomura in the current investigation over its apparently illegal deals may have had similar dealings with other "Big Four" brokerages.
Nomura shares, however, were higher by midday, up 10 yen at 1,380.

"It is too early to say that the scandal has been factored into the share price completely, but the inherent strength of (Nomura) is preventing it from plunging," a second-tier broker said. "If the share price continues to be firm, investors may move to buy back the shares much sooner than anyone expects."
